item.text:
Overall: **mostly yes, with a real caveat**. Scholz’s 2024 economic personnel and policy record is technocratic and growth-oriented, but the late-2024 replacement of Lindner with his close adviser Jörg Kukies gives some “trusted insider” counterweight.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Other IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | Agreement on 2025 budget and growth initiative | Federal Government | 2024-07-05 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116 | Scholz, Habeck, and Lindner agreed a budget outline and a growth initiative. The package emphasized tax relief, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, renewables, social housing, and growth potential, which points to broad-based prosperity rather than patronage. | 5B.1 |
| Support | Germany's Scholz working with industry to boost growth | Reuters | 2024-10-22 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/germanys-scholz-working-with-industry-to-boost-growth-3674390 | Scholz said his government was working to reduce bureaucracy, strengthen investment, attract skilled workers, and make energy affordable and sustainable. That is a substantive economic agenda aimed at long-run capacity, not short-term popularity buys. | 5B.1 |
| Support | Im Interview: Dr. Jörg Kukies, Bundesminister der Finanzen | Bundesministerium der Finanzen | 2024-11-21 | https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Monatsberichte/Ausgabe/2024/11/Kapitel/kapitel-2-interview.html | Kukies describes deep experience in finance and policy: BMF state secretary, chancellery economic/financial policy lead, G7/G20 Sherpa, economics training at Mainz/Paris/Harvard/Chicago, and Goldman Sachs background. That is strong evidence Scholz installed a competent economic professional. | 5B.2 |
| Support / caveat | Scholz names finance minister amid Germany's ruling coalition crisis | Euronews | 2024-11-07 | https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/07/scholz-names-finance-minister-amid-germanys-ruling-coalition-crisis-reports-claim | Scholz replaced Lindner with Kukies, described as a close adviser and experienced technocrat. This supports competence, but the “close adviser” framing is the main loyalty-based counterweight. | 5B.2 |
| Counterweight | Pressure mounts on Germany's Scholz to trigger election after coalition collapse | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-economy-minister-backs-scholzs-decision-to-end-coalition-3707376 | After the coalition collapse, Reuters described Kukies as a top chancellery official and close SPD ally, and noted the government was in political chaos. This suggests Scholz leaned on a trusted insider in a crisis, not a fully arm’s-length cabinet appointment. | 5B.2, 4B.10 |
| Counterweight | New German finance minister does not plan 2024 budget freeze | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-12 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/new-german-finance-minister-does-not-plan-2024-budget-freeze-3717218 | Kukies said there would be no budget freeze and the state could get through the year. That shows continuity and technical management, but it also reflects crisis stewardship after a political rupture rather than a stable, empowered expert team. | 5B.2 |

Search gap: I found **no evidence of family-member appointments, business-partner appointments, or direct patronage hires** in the economic portfolio. The strongest negative evidence is instead that Scholz’s late-2024 finance-minister appointment was a **close personal/working adviser**, which is a loyalty-style signal, though still paired with clear technocratic credentials.

Bottom line: Scholz **did** rely on capable economic professionals and did pursue a broad prosperity agenda, but the record is **mixed rather than cleanly technocratic** because Kukies was also one of Scholz’s closest insiders.
